details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, q11). It follows ANA's official press render closely: 7 ash doors (#b8aa8e rendered), a black basalt counter at 1.0 m, the black upper unit with the blind, monitor, bottle shelf and fridge, and the lit washi soffit. It now sits aft of the door-3 cross-aisle facing forward, as on the ANA map (tt_ana-business-class-cabin-layout_c.png). I found no in-service photo of the bar, so it is checked against the render only.

Door-2 welcome galley (m03) vs OMAAT in-service photo omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32. The layout matches: control panel over two ovens, centre landscape monitor, beverage maker and cubby, tall smoked-glass cabinet with an oval latch and a 'Return to seat' plate, black counter, ash lower doors. Three things are off: the monitor is too small, the counter edge is bronze where the photo shows aluminium, and the aisle end panels are navy where the photo shows charcoal.

Door-2 aft monuments (m04, m13): the centre galley, the 7K galley and the 7A closet exist now, with cream J backs. The centre galley is a standard white galley with exposed aluminium carts and copper latches. SANspotter sp_09 (looking along the door-2 galley passage) shows ash lower doors with an aluminium counter edge on both sides of the passage. The J-cabin curtains at this line are missing.

Door 1 / F front wall / flight-deck door (m01, m02, q01). Full-height washi walls ahead of the suites and the ebony flight-deck door and lav now match TPG The-Suite-cabin_147 and the r2 references. Three problems remain: there are no curtains in the F front aisles (TPG 147 shows them in both), the washi print reads as high-contrast marble rather than soft ink clouds, and the forward galleys show a depth and height step with a lit gap above.

Lavatory exteriors: J ash bi-fold doors with the lit sign (m03, m05). The Y/PY lavs are white (m09, m11) and the F lav is ebony (m02). Proportions are right (door 1.86 m in a 2.15 m monument). The only real J-lav photo (OMAAT 32, left edge) shows a light/aluminium edge trim and a vertical aluminium grab handle, where the model has bronze frame bars and a square black pull.

F/J bulkhead, J face (m07) vs TPG The-Room-small-cabin-front_71 / _70: the cream colour now matches (model #a7a198 vs photo #a99f99 / #bcb2a1), and the seam and blue placards are present. Three problems: the curtains are near-black thin poles in the middle of each aisle, the photos show them gathered at the outboard side; and the wall boxes sit too low.

J/PY bulkhead, PY face (m08): the 2 + 4 tilted light-grey monitors, grey pockets, bassinets and slate curtains match py_37303 and the ANA map. The pocket column on the outboard panel is shorter than in TPG Premium-Economy-cabin-2_154 and py_37302, which show about 6 or 7 stacked pockets.

Door-4 group (q13, m09, m10): the plain PY aft wall with two grey boxes and curtains in both aisles, gathered at the centre side, now matches py_37302 and TPG Premium-Economy-cabin-1_153, where the ANA photo wall is #dfe3e8. The wheelchair lav, the right galley and the row-30/31 monitors follow the map.

Rear (door 5): the fore-aft galleys facing a 1.2 m work aisle, the outboard lavs aft of the door, the centre closet and baby lav, and the light-grey rear curtains now follow the ANA map and y_47300 (m11, m12, q19). No new-configuration photo exists to check it. The aft end wall of the work aisle is a blank glowing white panel.

Standard galley inserts (m01, m04, m12): aluminium ovens and carts, black beverage makers, black deck. The copper latches are oversized, saturated orange blocks (0.03×0.05×0.05 m, #a4533a metallic) that dominate every galley shot. The upper stowage doors are blank white slabs.

Curtains. The positions are right at J/PY, at the PY aft end and at the rear of economy. The F/J bundle renders #202028, against photos at #5e5655 (TPG 71) and #867c66 (TPG 147, F side). Every bundle is a straight 0.17×0.10 m column that reads as a pole. Curtains are missing at the F front and at the door-2 aft line.

Jump seats: there are 5 in total (door 1 ×2, door 2 ×1, door 5 ×2) and none at doors 3 and 4. A 777-300ER needs flight-attendant seats next to every Type A door. The door-2 seat covers the 7A closet door (both centred at x -2.25).

issues.detail: Curtain bundles: too dark, pole-shaped, gathered on the wrong side at F/J
issues.problem: addCurtain builds one straight extrude (0.17×0.10 m, full 2.18 m). In m07 and q01 it reads as a near-black post standing in the middle of the aisle. The F/J bundle is gathered on the centre side (xg = a.x1+0.09 for the right aisle, b.x0-0.09 for the left). Real curtains are tied back at mid-height and flare to about 0.3 m at the hem. At F/J and the door-2 aft J line they hang against the OUTBOARD panel. At the PY aft end they hang against the centre wall, which is already correct.
issues.evidence: TPG tpg_The-Room-small-cabin-front_71.jpg: right-aisle curtain at px 650-700 against the outboard panel, tied at about 45 % height, sample #5e5655. _70: curtain at px 930-1000 on the outboard side. tpg_The-Suite-cabin_147 F-side curtain #867c66 (warm light). tt cabin-1: J curtains at the door-2 aft line hang outboard of each aisle opening. Model m07 curtain #202028; q01 shows a navy post in the aisle.
issues.fix: src/10_mono.js: (1) MONMAT.curtainF.c '#38373e' -> '#57504e' and curtainC -> '#4f4a4b', r 0.95. (2) Replace _curtainGeo with a flared, tied bundle: three gExtrude pieces of the pleated section scaled to half-width 0.15 (y 0..0.55), 0.11 (0.55..1.10) and 0.075 (1.22..2.17), plus a 0.07 m tie band at y 1.10..1.22 (half-width 0.07, a darker curtain mat). Add each at the same xg. (3) In buildMonuments' partition-curtain loop, when clsAt(layout, a.z0-0.5)==='F', use xg = right ? b.x0 - 0.13 : a.x1 + 0.13 (outboard); keep the centre-side gather for J/PY.

issues.problem: It is built with buildGalley: galleyWhite body, exposed aluminium carts, copper latches. Seen from the door-2 cross-aisle (m04), it looks like an economy galley opposite the premium welcome galley.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments_b/sp_09.jpg (SANspotter, door-2 galley passage): both sides of the passage have ash lower doors (#afa39d / #897f7d, dim) with an aluminium counter edge and a charcoal deck (#65646f), plus aluminium ovens with blue LEDs above. Model m04 galley body #a5a5a3 with bare carts.
issues.fix: monoLayoutQA: give the door-2 aft centre galley and the 7K galley {ashDoors:true}. In buildGalley, when m.ashDoors is set, use the welcome-galley lower instead of the cart loop: monoBody to dk with MONMAT.barAsh, then n = round(w/0.36) ash door panels (gRBox(cw/n-0.01, 0.84, 0.014)) with ringPull, and an aluminium (MONMAT.alu) rail rather than bronze. Keep the standard upper bank.

issues.detail: Missing curtains at the F front and the door-2 aft J line
issues.problem: No curtain at the F cabin's front aisles (z ≈ 7.45) or at the aisle openings of the door-2 aft monuments (z = dz[1][1]+0.85). Photos show charcoal curtains at both.
issues.evidence: tpg_The-Suite-cabin_147.jpg: curtains in both F aisles at the front wall (px 640-660 and 1085-1130). tt_ana-business-class-cabin-1-scaled_c.png: dark curtains either side of the door-2 aft centre galley (px 0-40 and 590-620). Model m02, m13: none.
issues.fix: monoLayoutQA, after the door-2 block: const zJ = dz[1][1] + ML.d2aft - 0.06; M('curtain', -1.80, -0.80, zJ, zJ, {xg: -1.70, tone: 'C', h: 0}); M('curtain', 0.82, 1.80, zJ, zJ, {xg: 1.70, tone: 'C', h: 0}). For F: M('curtain', -1.68, -0.88, 7.45, 7.45, {xg: -1.58, tone: 'F', h: 0}); M('curtain', 0.82, 1.62, 7.45, 7.45, {xg: 1.52, tone: 'F', h: 0}).

issues.problem: buildWelcomeGalley: bezel 0.70×0.43, screen 0.66×0.37. In the photo the screen is taller than the adjacent ovens (screen 280 px vs oven 255 px, and the screen is farther from the camera). That puts it at about 0.85×0.49 m, a 39-40 in class.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments_b/omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32.jpg, measured: oven door px 320-575 tall, screen px 130-410 tall. Model m03: the screen is about 0.77× the oven height.
issues.fix: buildWelcomeGalley: mc = -w/2 + 0.92; bezel gRBox(0.90, 0.54, ...) at y 1.68; screen gQuad(0.86, 0.49); the shelf lip under it at y 1.39. Shift the beverage maker to mc - 0.25; the cabinet at gc = w/2 - 0.3 still clears it (its left edge is at 0.58).

issues.detail: Welcome end panels are navy; the real ones are charcoal
issues.problem: MONMAT.navyPanel '#16172a' renders #222331 / #2d2f3c (clearly blue) in m04 and m13. The real portrait-monitor end panel is warm dark grey. The portrait monitor is also small and low: 0.27×0.48 screen centred at 1.55 m, while the photo shows it filling the top third of the panel, centre about 1.7 m.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments_b/sp_09.jpg end panel sample #46433b (dim cabin light). The OMAAT 32 upper frame is #1b1913.
issues.fix: MONMAT.navyPanel.c -> '#2d2b29' (keep r 0.35). In welcomeEnds: bezel gRBox(0.36, 0.64, ...) at y 1.68, screen gQuad(0.33, 0.60) at y 1.68.

issues.detail: No jump seats at doors 3 and 4; the door-2 jump seat covers the closet door
issues.problem: L.jumps has 5 seats. Every Type A door needs an adjacent flight-attendant seat. At door 2, [-2.25, dz[1][1], -1] is exactly on the 7A closet's centred 0.72 m door.
issues.evidence: Code: monoLayoutQA L.jumps, and the buildMon 'closet' branch (door centred at cx). m13 shows the closet face.
issues.fix: Door 2: in the closet branch, when m.jumpSide is set, draw a 0.40 m door at cx + 0.2*sign(cx)... or simply move the closet door inboard (x -2.00) and the jump seat to x -2.42 at width 0.40. Doors 3 and 4 need positions from the user (see questions). As a stopgap, for door 4 add [-2.05, dz[3][0], 1] on the wheelchair-lav face outboard of its door, after checking the lav-door span in buildMon. Keep the onCounter filter.

issues.detail: Wall boxes on the J faces sit too low
issues.problem: litPocket wall boxes on the F/J J face (buildBulkhead) and on the J backs (monoBack) are at y 1.30. The photos show grey wall boxes just under the bin line, at about 1.6-1.7 m, on the centre and outboard panels.
issues.evidence: tpg_The-Room-small-cabin-front_71.jpg: boxes at px y 220-280 with the bin bottom at px ≈215, colour #a1a298. tt cabin-1: box on the 7A closet at px y 355-425, just below the bin line.
issues.fix: buildBulkhead and monoBack: change the wall-box y from 1.30 to 1.62. Use MONMAT.wallBox c '#cfd0c8'. Also add one box at cx ± 0.35 on the centre F/J J face at 1.62.

issues.detail: Oversized copper latches on standard galleys
issues.problem: The cart latches (0.03×0.05×0.05) and upper-unit latches are saturated orange blocks, the most prominent thing in m01, m04 and m12.
issues.evidence: scratchpad/r0/m12_rearG.png, m01_d1fwd.png. sp_09 shows small red turn-buttons on the upper units.
issues.fix: buildGalley: cart latch gRBox(0.022, 0.035, 0.03); upper latch gRBox(0.016, 0.03, 0.02); MONMAT.copper c '#8f3a2c', m 0.4.

issues.detail: Door-1 forward galley step and gap
issues.problem: The centre galley (z1 4.60, h 2.10) and the right galley (z1 4.78, h 2.15, x0 0.62 vs 0.60) leave a visible step, a 2 cm slot, and a lit ceiling gap over the centre unit.
issues.evidence: scratchpad/r0/m01_d1fwd.png (bright strip above the centre galley at px y 110-125).
issues.fix: monoLayoutQA: set the right door-1 galley x0 = 0.60 and h 2.10, or give the centre galley h 2.15. Close the top with a 0.05 m laminate cap up to the ceiling line.

issues.problem: The model's J lav has bronze frame bars and a square black pull. The only in-service view (OMAAT 32, left) shows a light edge trim and a vertical aluminium grab handle.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments_b/omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32.jpg px 45-130, door #ccb588 (warm light); handle about 0.03×0.14 m at about 1.0 m.
issues.fix: buildMon lav, J branch: use MONMAT.alu for the frame bars (or drop them). Replace the square pull with gRBox(0.03, 0.14, 0.03) MONMAT.steel at y 1.0 inboard, keeping the occupancy plate.

issues.detail: Washi F front wall reads as marble
issues.problem: The atlas washi on bulkF shows large, high-contrast grey veins (m02). The real wall is soft, low-contrast ink clouds on a pale ground.
issues.evidence: tpg_The-Suite-cabin_147 wall #aba894 and _63 #bdbca6 (warm light) with soft cloud mottling. Model m02 #afaead with sharp veins.
issues.fix: Reduce the washi panel contrast for bulkF (flatten the atlas 'washi' multiplier toward 1 by about 50 %, or lerp the UV-sampled tone with c). Lift bulkF c to '#d2d2d6'.

issues.detail: PY outboard pocket column too short
issues.problem: buildBulkhead draws 4 pockets at 0.20-0.98 m on the PY outboard panel. TPG 154 and py_37302 show about 6 or 7 stacked pockets reaching about 1.4 m.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments_b/tpg_Premium-Economy-cabin-2_154.jpg (pocket column at px 930-970), ref/ana/py_37302-lang-multi.jpg lower left.
